concept.hr: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT i NS odgovaraju različito; CNAME ne smije na vrh zone
concept.en: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT and NS resolve differently; no CNAME at the zone apex

summary.hr: Složi malu zonu i pitaj je: nadimak i kanonsko ime, izmjenjivači pošte, NODATA ili NXDOMAIN, delegiranje i zona koja se zbog CNAME-a na vrhu ne učita.
summary.en: Build a small zone and query it: alias and canonical name, mail exchangers, NODATA or NXDOMAIN, delegation, and a zone that won't load with a CNAME at its apex.
